q.st-001.o1: Friday evening and no plans at all. Look around home: what if you slipped away for one night?
q.st-002.o1: Unfold the map and pick the lakeside campsite: close, quiet, water nearby.
q.st-003.o1: Drop by the outdoor gear shop.
q.st-003.o3: Get a sleeping bag: nights by the water are cool.
q.st-003.o4: A lantern wouldn't hurt either. But it's up to you.
q.st-004.o1: Head for the lake. No need to hurry: the road is part of the break too.
q.elise-bike-area.choice: Stop by Elise's: she asked you to look at the new bike area
q.elise-bike-area.o1: Talk to Elise: she needs someone on a bike to try out the new bike parking.
q.st-005.o1: Say hello to Elise at reception: she'll show you your pitch.
q.st-005.o2: Pitch your tent at your spot by the lake.
q.st-005.o3: Gather some firewood for the evening.
ev.neighbours-firewood: Your campsite neighbours had firewood to spare and shared some with you.
dlg.elise-greeting.hello: Hi! I'm Elise, I look after everything here by the lake. Glad to see you!
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c1: Where can I leave the bike?
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c2: Thanks! Where's a good spot for the tent?
dlg.elise-greeting.hello.c3: How's my bike doing under the shelter?
dlg.elise-greeting.bike: All the way here by bike? Respect! It'll stay dry and safe under the shelter by my cabin.
dlg.elise-greeting.shelter: Dry and cosy, just as I promised. I even oiled the chain: it was squeaking across the whole meadow!
dlg.elise-greeting.spot: By the pines: it's quiet there, and in the morning you can see the lake from your tent.
dlg.elise-greeting.bye: Have a lovely evening! If you need anything, I'm in the cabin with the green door.
dlg.road-apples.title: Apples by the road
dlg.road-apples.box: By the roadside: a wooden crate of apples and a sign — “Help yourself! From our orchard.”
dlg.road-apples.box.c1: Take an apple and leave a “Thank you!” note
dlg.road-apples.crunch: The apple is crisp and tart-sweet. The road suddenly feels shorter.
dlg.road-apples.wave: You quietly thank the unknown gardener. Maybe next time.
fact.nl-no-wild-camping: True wild camping is not allowed anywhere in the Netherlands: pitch a tent only where overnight stays are permitted.
fact.nl-signboard-rules: In Natuurmonumenten areas the yellow sign at the entrance lists what is allowed; anything not on it is not allowed.
fact.nl-sbb-pole-camping-closed: Staatsbosbeheer closed all 17 of its pole-camping sites from 1 June 2020, citing fires, litter and rule-breaking.
